districtFact: Sarasota County Schools publishes a districtwide academic calendar with student days, professional days, mini breaks, staff calendar groups, and an inclement weather makeup note. Campus events, athletics, testing, performances, and graduation details should be checked with the assigned school.

about.title: About Sarasota County Schools
about.content: Sarasota County Schools is the countywide public school district for Sarasota County, Florida. The district serves Sarasota, North Port, Venice, Englewood, Nokomis, Osprey, Laurel, and nearby Gulf Coast communities. Its district academic calendar lists the student start date, teacher and staff return dates, grading period endings, professional days, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, mini breaks, staff calendar milestones, Memorial Day, and the final student and staff days.

about.title: What This Calendar Covers
about.content: This page covers districtwide Sarasota County Schools academic dates. It does not replace school-level calendars for athletics, testing, performances, graduation, program events, or campus-specific announcements.

districtFaqs.q: What school district serves Sarasota, Florida?
districtFaqs.a: Public schools in Sarasota are served by Sarasota County Schools. The districtwide academic calendar applies to systemwide holidays, breaks, professional days, and student attendance dates.

districtFaqs.q: Does Sarasota County Schools include North Port and Venice?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. Sarasota County Schools serves Sarasota, North Port, Venice, Englewood, Nokomis, Osprey, Laurel, and other Sarasota County communities.

districtFaqs.q: Does the Sarasota County Schools calendar include school events?
districtFaqs.a: The district academic calendar covers systemwide dates such as the first day, last day, holidays, breaks, professional days, grading period endings, and staff calendar notes. Campus events, athletics, testing, performances, and graduation details may be published separately by each school.

districtFaqs.q: Can Sarasota County Schools change dates after weather closures?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. The official calendar notes that makeup days may be used after weather-related closures. Check district announcements before relying on late-year dates.

districtFaqs.q: What are mini breaks on the Sarasota County Schools calendar?
districtFaqs.a: Mini breaks are district-listed no-school days for students and selected staff groups. They are separate from Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, and Spring Break and should be treated as childcare planning dates.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify Sarasota County Schools calendar changes?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official Sarasota County Schools events/calendar page and campus announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates summarizes official calendar documents and is not affiliated with Sarasota County Schools.
